method: editable deterministic Godot world-space procedural albedo; no bitmap or mesh changes
palette_calibration: paired actual clear/cloudy engine previews: increase meadow blue and dirt blue/green from LOOK_SPEC starting swatches to compensate existing warm light, reduce orange saturation; lighting untouched
color_space: authoring hex sRGB converted once using Color.srgb_to_linear for painted shader uniforms; legacy kinds unchanged
filter: smooth interpolation and fwidth fade between 0.25 and 0.65 pixel footprints; no TIME, cell-local seeds or periodic UVs
projection: ground world XZ; risers world ZY or XY by dominant world normal; all coordinates measured in metres
edge_policy: existing semantic-mask four-neighbor 0.065m shoulder retained; dirt shoulder uses matching painted meadow; sand/cobble retain original policy
scope: grass/dirt and existing shared elevation riser material only; sand/cobble/wet-shoreline/raw-marker/water keep previous shading
